verdict.rationale: Bland pathways have versioning: edits go to a draft while live calls keep using the published production version, and a version can be promoted to staging to test before it goes live. Agents also get development, staging, and production environments. Review is supported through staging test calls and the testbed. Rollback of a user's own pathway or agent to a prior version is never explicitly documented; the release-pinning and canary docs cover Bland's enterprise infrastructure releases, not user automations. Missing for 10: explicit documented rollback to a prior pathway/agent version, version history/diff review, independent or hands-on corroboration.
